newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways says competition hurt Q1.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways says competition hurt Q1.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Tuesday increased competition in what is already a weak quarter hurt its sales and increased the company's losses.

The building materials supplier reported sales of $487.6 million, down from $526.7 million a year ago. Payless Cashways also posted a net loss of $8.1 million, or $0.24 a share, compared to $7.6 million, or $0.23 a share one year ago.
Company officials said Payless Cashways will now focus on the spring selling season and its so-called Dual Path business strategy for the do-it-yourself market.
The company's shares closed Tuesday unchanged at 2.
